summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a registered direct offering of 522,876 common shares at $7.65 per share, raising approximately $4.0 million gross. The offering was made under an existing effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3 and is expected to close on June 29, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The company plans to use net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. This ordinary equity capital raising does not constitute a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
